title: Two Arrested in Laredo After Children's Hospital Reports Infant Abuse
excerpt: Two people, ages 19 and 20, have been arrested on a state jail felony charge after a children's hospital in Corpus Christi reported an infant had suffered alleged non-accidental trauma, according to Laredo police.
content:
Two people have been arrested in Laredo after a children's specialty hospital in Corpus Christi reported that an infant had suffered alleged non-accidental trauma, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Melanie Arellano, 19, and Raymundo Campos, 20, are each charged with injury to a child/elderly/disabled individual with reckless bodily injury, a state jail felony, according to the report.

On June 20, 2026, the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services received a report from the children's hospital alleging the infant had suffered non-accidental trauma, according to the report. The Laredo Police Department's Special Investigations Unit took over the investigation, and detectives found probable cause for arrest warrants for both Arellano and Campos. Both warrants were served on Nov. 3, 2026.

Both were booked into the Webb County Jail on a $100,000 bond each and remained in custody as of Friday morning, Nov. 6, according to the report.

The report did not state the infant's age, the infant's relationship to the two people arrested, or the infant's current condition. The charges are allegations, and the case has not been tried.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times.
